game_context: Bureaucratic desk game: redacting classified memos with a marker, toilet intel strips, desk lamp tension, coffee and cigarettes, rubber fly eraser during onboarding. Tone: dry office satire, tactile Foley, not cartoonish.

sounds.name: shift_ambient_loop
sounds.prompt: Seamless looping ambient office atmosphere for a tense bureaucratic night shift: distant HVAC hum, faint fluorescent buzz, muffled hallway footsteps, subtle paper rustle. Minimal melody, low-key suspense, no vocals. Game background loop.

sounds.name: menu_ambient_loop
sounds.prompt: Seamless looping slow-tempo dark spy jazz for a satirical bureaucratic game menu. Muted Rhodes piano, brushed hi-hat, soft upright bass, minor-key chord voicings, smoky cold-war intrigue and conspiracy mood. Restrained, adult, melancholic noir lounge — NOT cartoon, NOT playful, NOT chiptune, NOT bouncy, NOT children's melody or nursery tune. No vocals. Perfect seamless game loop.

sounds.name: tension_layer_loop
sounds.implementation: AudioManager.set_tension_layer — ramps shift_ambient_loop volume + pitch, no separate track
sounds.prompt: Unused file. Tension is code-driven on shift ambient.

sounds.name: dark_hold_stinger
sounds.prompt: Short cinematic stinger when desk lamp cuts to total darkness at end of shift: low braam, power-down thump, brief silence tail. Bureaucratic horror, not explosive.

sounds.name: onboarding_ambient_loop
sounds.prompt: Seamless looping interior office room tone: HVAC air conditioning hum, faint fluorescent light buzz, muted computer fan, distant muffled building ventilation. Indoor bureaucratic workspace, no crickets, no birds, no wind, no outdoor nature, no forest, no street traffic, no melody, no vocals.

sounds.name: marker_scribble_loop
sounds.implementation: scripts/marker_friction_noise.gd — low-pass white noise, volume mapped to cursor speed while drawing
sounds.prompt: Not generated. Runtime procedural noise modulated by marker movement.

sounds.name: marker_line_loop
sounds.implementation: Same as G1; line draw mode uses slightly quieter noise in marker_friction_noise.gd
sounds.prompt: Not generated. Same procedural system as G1 with lower gain.

sounds.name: stroke_release
sounds.prompt: Quick marker lift-off from paper: tiny squeak and soft tap as pen leaves surface. Single short Foley one-shot.

sounds.name: wrong_mark_accent
sounds.prompt: Soft negative UI accent for incorrect redaction: muted low thud with brief dissonant tone, understated not punishing. Office game feedback.

sounds.name: mug_smear
sounds.prompt: Short delicate Foley: coffee ring lightly smearing on office paper, faint wet sticky drag, soft tacky rub once then stop. No long splash, no pour, no drip sequence, no heavy liquid, no static. Brief close-mic paper wetness only.

sounds.name: score_plus_one
sounds.prompt: Almost inaudible positive feedback: single faint paper-fiber rustle or soft typewriter key tap, extremely quiet close-mic Foley. No melody, no chime, no arcade ping. Whisper-subtle UI tick.

sounds.name: score_plus_two
sounds.prompt: Barely audible double tap: two very soft paper clicks or muted typewriter keys in quick succession, extremely quiet. No musical notes, no bright chimes. Slightly more present than +1 but still subliminal.

sounds.name: score_minus_half
sounds.prompt: Whisper-quiet minor penalty: faint muted thud like pencil eraser tap on paper or soft fabric shift. No buzzer, no descending arcade blip, no dissonance. Nearly silent disappointment.

sounds.name: stamp_slam
sounds.implementation: tools/generate_stamp_thud.py — dull low sine thud + brief paper noise
sounds.prompt: Not ElevenLabs. Run: python tools/generate_stamp_thud.py

sounds.name: memo_spawn
sounds.prompt: Light paper swoosh Foley only: thin memo sheet gliding through air, soft flutter and airy rustle, gentle swish. No impact, no hit, no thud, no wood knock, no plastic tap, no metal, no briefcase slam, no static. Pure lightweight paper movement, very quiet close mic.

sounds.name: memo_land
sounds.prompt: Pure paper Foley: single office memo sheet dropping onto wooden desk — soft papery flap, light thud, tiny settle rustle, done. No metal, no plastic click, no mechanical clank, no latch, no gear, no static, no hiss, no synth. Only paper on wood, close microphone.

sounds.name: memo_discard
sounds.prompt: Finished memo swept off desk or into out tray: quick paper whisk and faint bin rustle.

sounds.name: shift_report_arrive
sounds.prompt: Formal shift closure report extracted from briefcase and placed on desk: leather case creak, heavier paper stack, official thud.

sounds.name: toilet_handle_pull
sounds.prompt: Old chrome toilet flush handle pulled and released: metallic clank, chain rattle, brief tank slosh. Bathroom stall Foley.

sounds.name: intel_strip_spawn
sounds.prompt: Clean Foley only: thin toilet-paper intel strip sliding out in two soft puffs — puff puff, gentle paper flutter and slide, light rustle. No metal clank, no mechanical click, no static, no hiss, no roll spindle squeak. Close-mic soft paper movement only.

sounds.name: intel_strip_land
sounds.prompt: Thin paper strip landing on tile or metal stall surface: light papery tap.

sounds.name: handle_attract_creak
sounds.prompt: Delicate toilet flush chain Foley: loose metal chain links swaying and tinkling softly once, faint gentle clink-clink, subtle handle wobble. No drum, no percussion hit, no thump, no bang, no static. Quiet bathroom stall, close mic, barely audible.

sounds.name: coffee_sip
sounds.prompt: Single quick sip from ceramic coffee mug: small liquid slurp, swallow, mug set down clink. Office break Foley.

sounds.name: clock_time_ping
sounds.prompt: Bright UI ping when shift clock gains ten seconds: crisp digital chime with tiny clock tick accent. Positive time bonus.

sounds.name: mug_set_down
sounds.prompt: Delicate Foley: small ceramic coffee mug set gently on wooden desk, soft muted clink and tiny wood tap, very quiet close mic. No loud thud, no scrape, no rattle, no static. Brief single contact then silence.

sounds.name: cigarette_puff
sounds.prompt: Clear cigarette inhale Foley: person draws smoke through lit cigarette, audible soft inhale breath, gentle paper crackle at filter tip, faint tobacco hiss. Single puff inhale only, close mic, realistic not silent. No exhale cough, no music, no static.

sounds.name: cigarette_on_ashtray
sounds.prompt: Cigarette placed into glass ashtray: tiny tap, ash crumble, brief sizzle.

sounds.name: cigarette_stub_out
sounds.prompt: Cigarette burns out in ashtray: final faint crackle then silence, stub extinguished.

sounds.name: hand_twitch
sounds.prompt: Nervous hand jitter on desk: quick fabric sleeve rustle and pen rattle, caffeine jitters Foley.

sounds.name: fly_landing_enter
sounds.prompt: Cartoon-adjacent but realistic fly buzzing in and landing on desk: wing buzz approaching, tiny tap on wood.

sounds.name: fly_landing_settle
sounds.prompt: Tiny insect settle tick: fly stops moving, one faint leg tap on desk surface.

sounds.name: fly_walk_start
sounds.prompt: Short fly skitter start: rapid tiny leg taps on paper, brief buzz.

sounds.name: fly_walk_stop
sounds.prompt: Fly skitter stops abruptly: last few leg taps then sudden silence.

sounds.name: fly_flee_burst
sounds.prompt: Fly buzz burst taking off quickly: sharp wing buzz accelerating away from desk.

sounds.name: fly_return_whoosh
sounds.prompt: Fly flying back toward desk: directional whoosh with wing buzz approaching.

sounds.name: fly_return_land
sounds.prompt: Fly lands back on desk after flight: soft buzz cut and tiny landing tick.

sounds.name: fly_erase_click
sounds.prompt: insect fly buzzing

sounds.name: lamp_flicker_click
sounds.prompt: Tiny desk lamp switch click: soft vintage toggle tick, brief filament buzz, office not horror. No bang, no braam, no static burst. Very short single click.

sounds.name: lamp_final_off
sounds.prompt: Quiet desk lamp power off: soft click then faint hum dying out, gentle not scary. No horror stinger, no braam, no dramatic drop. Bureaucratic office lamp switching off.

sounds.name: lamp_relight
sounds.prompt: Desk lamp clicks back on: soft warm toggle, gentle filament hum starting, quiet office relight. No dramatic swell, no horror, no bright chime. Brief practical lamp on.

sounds.name: menu_play_confirmed
sounds.prompt: Brief office desk confirm when starting work: single soft mechanical switch or toggle click, then a warm subtle metallic chime — like turning on a desk lamp or intercom at a bureaucratic workspace. Clean, satisfying, close-mic Foley. NOT noise blob, NOT static burst, NOT whoosh, NOT cartoon, NOT dramatic sting. No music, no vocals.

sounds.name: menu_save_wipe
sounds.prompt: SAVE redaction wipe on menu: dry marker erase swipe across paper with soft save chime.

sounds.name: review_tick_blink
sounds.prompt: End-of-paper review overlay blink: soft tick or cross UI pulse, gentle attention getter not alarm.

sounds.name: missed_word_blink
sounds.prompt: Highlight blink on missed planted word in memo text: subtle warning tone, paper-review feedback.
